source_title: Nintendo Switch 2 Has 9 Big Games Officially Confirmed for November - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Nintendo Switch 2 gamers have nine big games to look forward to in November 2026, with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake being the headliner. Nintendo Switch 2 has had an incredibly strong 2026, with major third-party games like Resident Evil Requiem and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 released alongside a nice selection of first-party exclusives, including highly-rated games like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Pokemon Pokopia .
The new Switch 2 releases keep coming at a steady pace. Just recently, Nintendo Switch 2 gamers were treated to Nintendo Switch Sports Resort and Final Fantasy Resonance , and even more games are releasing for the home console/handheld hybrid before October is over. But with November right around the corner, some fans may be wondering what's next for Switch 2, and luckily, nine big games have already been confirmed for next month.
List of New Switch 2 Games Coming Soon
Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered - November 3
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - November 5
Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition - November 5
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered - November 10
Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy - November 12
The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ - November 19
The major new Switch 2 releases for November 2026 will kick off with Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered on November 3, followed by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on November 5 . Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition is also releasing on November 5, while DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered is coming on November 10 alongside Warhammer Survivors . Barbie Rewind , Metaphor: ReFantazio , and Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy are all releasing on November 12. And finally, The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ is coming on November 19.
It likely goes without saying, but the big headlining new Switch 2 game of November 2026 is undoubtedly The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . Ocarina of Time is a full-blown remake of the Nintendo 64 classic, boasting significantly improved visuals and new features like a dedicated jump button and the Hall of Fallen Heroes . It's quite easily one of the most highly-anticipated new game releases of the year, and unless things go awry, will be a must-buy for Switch 2 gamers.
The other first-party Nintendo release coming to Switch 2 in November is the Switch 2 Edition of Pikmin 4 . The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Pikmin 4 features enhanced visuals, the Dandori Academy mode , voice controls, and GameShare support. Pikmin 4 is already a rather expansive game, but the Switch 2 Edition will make it bigger and better.
Overall, the Switch 2 is going to have a busy November, even without GTA 6 releasing on the platform. The lack of GTA 6 on Switch 2 may be disappointing for some, but the Ocarina of Time remake and other new games coming in November should help ease the pain at least a little bit.
